title: should load the stream list on the Logs Build page with no stream preselected
verifies: the stream select is enabled and lists the ingested e2e_automate logs stream with no preselected stream (STREAM_LIST_WITHOUT_STREAM 'build')

title: should load the stream list on a new Dashboard Add Panel with no prior stream selection
verifies: a brand-new panel (editMode=false) loads the stream list on mount and lists e2e_automate with no prior stream selection

title: should drop logs streams from the list when the stream type changes to metrics
verifies: switching the stream type reloads the list and the stale-response guard drops e2e_automate

title: should filter stream options by a case-insensitive substring search
verifies: the searchable stream select filters options to those matching the substring

title: should load the stream list on the Metrics Visualize page with a blank stream
verifies: the metrics Visualize workspace loads the stream list with a blank stream (STREAM_LIST_WITHOUT_STREAM 'metrics'), conditionally skipped when no metrics streams exist
